thread:
Anna (docs): Morning team — quick async standup. Shipping samplekit v0.9 today. What I did: landed docs for samplekit quickstart, added Windows notes, updated README with a short usage example. Blocker: CI flake on macOS wheel job. Today: monitor canary, cut release if green, follow up on CI fix PR.

Raj: Nice — can you drop the PR link? Also I pushed a tiny fix to the example server (commit abc123).

Anna (docs): PR is https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/4821 — that's docs + quickstart. The failing job is `macos-wheels` (see brief log snippet below).
```
# macos-wheels job
ERROR: could not write to /private/var/tmp/some-cache-dir: permission denied
```

Taylor: Taking this. Assigning myself to CI flake triage. Seeing a sporadic permission error on /tmp mount on the runner. Hypothesis: cached wheel artifact permissions mismatch after cleanup. I'll rerun with cache busted.

Leo: Quick heads-up for the quickstart: sampleapp expects REDWOOD_API_KEY env. I added a snippet to docs using rwctl to fetch creds: `rwctl login --org demo && export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(rwctl token)` — saved new example to the PR.

Anna (docs): :thumbsup: Added that snippet to the quickstart. Can someone do a quick smoke on Linux? @Maria, you free?

Maria: I can run a smoke now. Running `./scripts/smoke.sh sampleapp --region=us-west2` locally.

Maria: Local smoke passed but CI canary still shows macos-wheels failing. I re-ran the job once and the same flake popped.

Taylor: Reran again with cache cleared -> macos-wheels passed. Uploading artifacts and re-triggering the docs release canary.

Anna (docs): Awesome — thanks. I'll wait for the final canary. ETA ~30m to cut tag once green. If anyone spots odd generated codeblocks in the quickstart, please flag here.

Raj: Quick FYI — samplekit SDK snippet in the README still uses the old `create_client()` signature. Filed issue #133. I'll open a tiny PR to update the examples later today.

Anna (docs): Excellent. If Raj's update is a small example change, I'll hold the tag for it. If it's going to be >30m, we'll ship and patch in the next minor.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary passed on commit abc1234 for layers: docs, samplekit. Release queued.

Anna (docs): Thanks all — blocker resolved (CI cache). Today's plan: finalize release notes, update changelog, and watch the canary. Ping here if you want to review copy or spot any regressions in quickstarts.
